label: US travel executives reporting AI improves personalisation
question: What returns do travel executives report from AI?
answer: 33% of US travel executives say AI improves customer personalisation and 36% report higher-quality outputs.
sample: 86 mostly US-based travel executives, surveyed for Remapping travel with agentic AI (McKinsey with Skift)
methodology: McKinsey with Skift, Remapping travel with agentic AI, September 2025. Sample of 86 mostly US-based travel executives, small enough that the levels are directional rather than precise.
